                current_max_r_i = min(current_max_r_i, max(0.0, dist_ij - radii[j]))
            
            new_radii[i] = current_max_r_i
        
        # Update the radii for the next iteration
        radii = new_radii
        
        # Ensure no radii become negative due to floating point inaccuracies
        radii[radii < 0] = 0 
           
    return radii
